overview_description.description: Circle Medical provides primary care Doctors in-person at your home or work. Your care will be led by one of their board-certified physicians, all of whom were selected for their experience and patient-centered approach. Doctor visits are insured under most plans. Using the app, you may scan your insurance card to check for eligibility and coverage. Doctors are available in San Francisco including evenings and weekends.

product.name: Primary Care Visits
product.description: Medical consultations with board-certified primary care providers available via video or in-person to diagnose, treat, and manage a wide range of health conditions.

product.name: ADHD Diagnosis and Treatment
product.description: Remote and in-person evaluation, diagnosis, and management of Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder including medication management and follow-up care.

identifier.value: Hormone Therapy and Gender Affirming Care

product.name: Hormone Therapy and Gender Affirming Care
product.description: Medical consultations and treatment plans for hormone therapy and gender-affirming care provided via telehealth and select in-person clinics.

product.name: Mental Health Services
product.description: Diagnosis, treatment, and management of mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, and seasonal affective disorder through telehealth and in-person visits.

identifier.value: Sleep Care and At-Home Sleep Studies

product.name: Sleep Care and At-Home Sleep Studies
product.description: Comprehensive sleep evaluations and treatment for sleep disorders, including at-home sleep studies, provided through telemedicine and in-person consultations.
